title.narrative: Advancing Respect for Human Rights by Businesses (ARBHR) in Uganda

description.narrative: The Advancing Respect for Human Rights by Businesses (ARBHR) in Uganda project forms part of EU¿s support to implement Uganda's National Action Plan (NAP) on Business and Human Rights. It seeks to reduce human rights abuses, particularly those impacting women and children, connected to business activities in Uganda.
